# Mukesh Saree Centre

> Mukesh Saree Centre is a premier saree and ethnic wear retailer and wholesaler based in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India, established in 1978. We offer authentic Paithani sarees, Banarasi silk sarees, bridal sarees, wedding sarees, Malvika saree collections, soft cotton drapes, and institutional uniform saree solutions (school, teacher, corporate, hospital) both online and at our Gandhibagh, Nagpur showroom with Cash on Delivery across India.
